docs.title: stellar-numerics
docs.text:
stellar-numerics is a Python package for working with stellar-rank numerics.

This documentation is a work in progress. It currently includes installation guidance and an API reference.

  • API Reference: browse the documented Python interface.

docs.title: Protocol
docs.text:
Bases: Enum

Enumeration of the protocols for Gaussian conversion. Deterministic and Probabilistic.

docs.title: max_trace_distance_precision(protocol, nb_copies, to_profile, from_profile=None, from_rank=None)
docs.text:
Bound conversion error using stellar profiles and a protocol.

Parameters:

Name Type Description Default protocol Protocol

Deterministic (standard) or postselected conversion protocol.

required nb_copies int

Number of input copies used in the conversion.

required to_profile StellarProfile

Profile of the pure target state.

required from_profile StellarProfile or None

Profile of the input state. Required for the standard protocol and ignored for the postselected protocol.

None from_rank int or None

Input stellar rank. Required for the postselected protocol.

None

Returns:

Type Description float

Maximum trace-distance precision bound for the selected protocol.

Raises:

Type Description ValueError

If the required input profile or rank is missing.

TypeError

If the target profile represents a mixed state.

Warns:

Type Description UserWarning

If an input profile is supplied for the postselected protocol.

docs.title: max_trace_distance_precision_pure_pure_std(from_profile, to_profile, nb_copies)
docs.text:
Compute the deterministic conversion bound for pure states.

Parameters:

Name Type Description Default from_profile StellarProfile

Stellar profile of the pure input state.

required to_profile StellarProfile

Stellar profile of the pure target state.

required nb_copies int

Number of input copies used in the conversion.

required

Returns:

Type Description float

Maximum trace-distance bound evaluated over the ranks available in both profiles.

Notes

Implements Eq. (36) of [HGFFC25]. The profiles are expected to contain contiguous ranks from zero through their maximum rank.

docs.title: max_trace_distance_precision_mixed_pure_std(from_profile, to_profile, nb_copies)
docs.text:
Compute the deterministic conversion bound from a mixed to pure state.

Parameters:

Name Type Description Default from_profile StellarProfile

Stellar profile of the mixed input state.

required to_profile StellarProfile

Stellar profile of the pure target state.

required nb_copies int

Number of input copies used in the conversion.

required

Returns:

Type Description float

Squared maximum bound evaluated over the ranks available in both profiles.

Notes

Implements Eq. (38) of [HGFFC25]. The profiles are expected to contain contiguous ranks from zero through their maximum rank.

docs.title: max_trace_distance_precision_pure_pure_post(to_profile, from_rank, nb_copies)
docs.text:
Compute the postselected conversion bound for pure states.

Parameters:

Name Type Description Default to_profile StellarProfile

Stellar profile of the pure target state.

required from_rank int

Stellar rank of the input state.

required nb_copies int

Number of input copies used in the conversion.

required

Returns:

Type Description float

Trace-distance bound evaluated at target rank nb_copies * from_rank.

Notes

Implements the looser bound in Eq. (37) of [HFFC25]; the input state's profile is not needed.

docs.title: max_trace_distance_precision_mixed_pure_post(to_profile, from_rank, nb_copies)
docs.text:
Compute the postselected conversion bound for a mixed input.

Parameters:

Name Type Description Default to_profile StellarProfile

Profile used to evaluate the bound at the target rank.

required from_rank int

Stellar rank of the input state.

required nb_copies int

Number of input copies used in the conversion.

required

Returns:

Type Description float

Squared trace-distance bound evaluated at target rank nb_copies * from_rank.

Notes

Implements the looser bound in Eq. (39) of [HFFC25].

docs.title: get_statevector(cutoff=None)
docs.text:
returns the statevector of a GaussianState object. From Chabaud draft Eq. [F15]

Parameters:

Name Type Description Default cutoff int

single-mode Fock space cutoff i.e. the highest Fock number reached

None

Returns:

Name Type Description res Statevector

output statevector as a :class:stellar.cvstates.Statevector object.

Raises:

Type Description TypeError

if the parameter cutoffis not an integer.

TypeError

if the parameter cutoff is not a strictly positive integer.

Notes

Formula is ill-defined for zero squeezing. Use a very small squeezing amplitude or :class:stellar.cvstates.CoherentState instead. Need to shift convention with respect to ours : xi-> xi* so theta -> - theta wrt paper

docs.title: GaussianParameters dataclass
docs.text:
Parameters describing a single-mode Gaussian state or operation.

Parameters:

Name Type Description Default x float

Real and imaginary parts of the displacement, respectively.

required y float

Real and imaginary parts of the displacement, respectively.

required r float

Non-negative squeezing magnitude.

required theta float

Squeezing phase in radians.

required Notes

Instances are immutable and hashable.

docs.title: displacement property
docs.text: complex: Displacement amplitude x + 1j*y.

docs.title: squeezing property
docs.text: complex: Complex squeezing parameter r * exp(1j*theta).

docs.text:

Enumeration of the methods to compute the objective function. Only 2 so far.

docs.title: OptimisationParameters dataclass
docs.text:
Configuration for computing stellar fidelities and profiles.

Parameters:

Name Type Description Default method Method

Representation used for the optimization objective: Fock-basis or Gaussian-state evaluation.

required target_cutoff int or None

Highest Fock number used to represent the target in the Fock basis. Required when method is :attr:Method.fock; ignored for :attr:Method.gaussian.

None niter int

Number of basin-hopping iterations.

250 x0 tuple of float

Initial values for displacement components, squeezing magnitude, and squeezing phase.

(0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 0.1) seed int or None

Random seed passed to the optimizer.

None

Raises:

Type Description ValueError

If Fock-basis optimization is selected without target_cutoff.

Warns:

Type Description UserWarning

If target_cutoff is supplied for Gaussian-state optimization.

docs.title: Requirements
docs.text: The package requires Python 3.10 or later and earlier than 3.14.

docs.title: Install from PyPI
docs.text: python -m pip install stellar-numerics

docs.title: Install from a local checkout
docs.text:
From the repository root

python -m pip install -e .

To install the documentation tools as well:

python -m pip install -e ".[docs]"

docs.title: Build or preview the documentation
docs.text:
From the repository root:

python -m mkdocs serve

Open the local address printed by MkDocs to preview the site. To build the static site, run:

python -m mkdocs build
